description: [Commercial Transit / Mobility] Metasearches car rentals, campervans, and local vehicle fleets across Europe, North America, and alpine corridors. Returns ranked options with option_id ready for affiliate deep-link generation. Does not book directly — acts as affiliate search layer.

corridor.description: Geographical corridor to optimize broker selection (EU_CH: AutoEurope/Localrent, NORTH_AMERICA: EconomyBookings/QEEQ, ALPINE_ADVENTURE: GetRentacar/BikesBooking)

dropoff_location.description: Optional dropoff city or airport code if different

pickup_location.description: Pickup city or airport code (e.g. MAD, ZRH, MIA, BCN, Malaga, JFK)

session_id.description: Optional product session id. If omitted, GEO360 creates one (trip_*). Pass the same id on later search/commit calls for the same trip.

sub_id.description: Optional affiliate sub-ID for calling agent attribution (e.g. meta_muse, grok, custom_ref)

name: geo360_search_car_rentals
